# Issue 10: Add first layout-suggestion prototype

## Summary

Prototype a simple rule-based suggestion engine that proposes ranked layouts and explains its reasoning.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fixed objects remain fixed
- [ ] Door clearance is preserved
- [ ] Layout suggestions are ranked
- [ ] Suggestions explain their reasoning
- [ ] User can reject or modify a suggestion

## Notes

Keep the first engine rule-based and local. Do not introduce cloud model dependencies for the MVP.
